##### Project general facts

Olbia is a contemporary residential development designed to combine refined architecture with the comfort of community-focused living. Thoughtfully planned to balance modern sophistication and everyday practicality, the project features elegant design, inviting communal spaces, and bright interiors that create a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Open-plan living and dining areas are enhanced by abundant natural light, while smart layouts and well-proportioned bedrooms ensure both functionality and comfort in every home.

The development is designed to foster a vibrant and well-rounded lifestyle, with landscaped outdoor areas, pedestrian-friendly promenades, and a curated collection of amenities that encourage both relaxation and recreation. From active leisure spaces to quiet corners for unwinding, Olbia creates a connected residential environment where residents can enjoy a sense of community alongside the convenience of modern urban living.

Each residence is finished with high-quality contemporary materials and carefully designed to maximize style and practicality. The apartments feature fully equipped kitchens fitted with German-made appliances and are delivered semi-furnished with built-in wardrobes, offering elegant and functional homes tailored to modern everyday living.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a vibrant and expansive mega-development located in the heart of Dubai. At the core of Town Square Dubai is the picturesque Town Square Park, which serves as the central hub for residents and visitors alike. The park features lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas, providing a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and creating a sense of unity and community spirit.

Town Square Dubai boasts a host of exceptional facilities and amenities, making it a vibrant and dynamic place to live. Residents can enjoy access to sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, as well as retail and dining outlets within the community. A Town Square Mall, with a variety of shops and entertainment options, further enriches the living experience.

The development's strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, Town Square Dubai is within proximity to schools, hospitals, and other essential services, offering residents a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.
